scope: Independent read-only review of durable30minute create pacing and production dispatcher/CLI integration. Only this report written; no core edits, network, uploads, sends or production DB writes.

reviewEvidence.atomicRace: Different jobs share history:pacing:<platform>:<numericid>. A single compareAppend CAS winner gets a grant. A loser performs only one reread and does not retry acquisition.
reviewEvidence.pause: Pacing is immediately before the existing dispatch-start CAS, which still passes the exact destination version to SQL. The migration requires this guard for a new dispatchStartedAt and checks pause, mode, history, canary and cooldown under the destination lock.
reviewEvidence.retryAndCrash: Slots are not refunded. Definite failure or a pre-dispatch crash can delay delivery, without accumulating catch-up credits. An ambiguous create remains unresolved independently of slot expiry.
reviewEvidence.corrections: Jobs with a known remoteId skip reservation; correction_pending jobs retain priority. The CLI pacing prefilter also exempts known remote edits.
reviewEvidence.fairness: Discovery and byte preparation retain never-attempted/least-recent ordering. Pacing is a channel-level admission limit, not a change to retained news identity, source facts or image licensing.
reviewEvidence.storage: Existing append-only service-role journal accepts the bounded history:pacing key; no new table or schema bypass. Generic SQL CAS serializes same-key attempts.

existingRegressionProof.scope: Owner-generated red/green receipts read independently; not represented as another independently run full suite.

limitations: No real Telegram/VK post, live schema apply, multi-process remote PostgreSQL race or native-platform visual acceptance performed in this review.
The policy limits new-create attempts using the trusted runner clock; a failed or paused reserved attempt can leave a quiet interval. No slot refund or burst catch-up is permitted.
A pause after the atomic dispatch marker cannot cancel an already-started provider request; existing ambiguous-outcome reconciliation remains required.
